1.e4 e6 2.d4 c5 3.d5.strategy: Gains space and attacks e6, though the pawn there is defended twice and nothing is lost. If Black trades on d5, the e-file opens and White's pawn on d5 takes the c6 and e6 squares from Black's pieces; if Black does not, White has a cramping wedge in the centre.
1.e4 e6 2.d4 c5 3.d5.name: Benoni Defence: French Benoni
